jurisdictions.name: Billings
notes: The Building Division is on the 5th floor of City Hall at 316 N. 26th Street.
Permit applications are submitted and tracked online through the City View portal; plans go in electronically, so only one set is required.
The city lists the 2021 International Residential Code and the 2021 International Swimming Pool & Spa Code, last adopted September 1, 2022 under Administrative Order #150.
For single-family homes, plumbing and electrical detail may be left off the plans if the mechanical equipment location is shown.

sources.title: Building Division FAQs - City of Billings

jurisdictions.name: Helena
notes: The Building Division handles building permits, applied for through the Civic Access online portal.
For one- and two-family dwellings, prefabricated pools less than 24 inches deep are listed as exempt from a building permit.
The page says an exemption does not authorize work that violates the code or other local ordinances.

sources.title: Building Permit Types - City of Helena

jurisdictions.name: Kalispell
jurisdictions.portal_name: Apply for Any Permit Here (online permit application)
notes: The Building Department lists permits for building, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, tenant improvements and fire suppression.
The city lists the 2021 International Residential Code and the 2021 International Swimming Pool and Spa Code as adopted codes.
Public Works may also require a Right-of-Way Permit or a Construction Stormwater Permit before a building permit is approved.

sources.title: Permits & Electronic Plan Review - City of Kalispell
